data.name: Parvati
data.gender_notes: Parvati is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit parvata, 'mountain', + the feminine suffix — 'daughter of the mountain'. Its root is Sanskrit parvata + ī. Parvati, consort of Shiva. Parvati is a Sanskrit name meaning “Daughter of the mountain”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Parvati expresses “Daughter of the mountain”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit parvata, 'mountain', + the feminine suffix — 'daughter of the mountain'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parvati total 33, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
